title: [BUILD] Statistical repair: CPCV runner — purge + embargo, N=6-8 (Sprint C 1b.2)
tier_rationale: New validation-stack module (CPCV) that becomes a sibling of CSCV for PBO. Two new files in src/forex_bot/backtest/ (cpcv.py + tests/backtest/test_cpcv.py) plus a 1-line bridge hook into src/forex_bot/factory/validation_runner.py. Touches statistical math (purge + embargo semantics) so equivalence/sanity gate + targeted tests are required.

in_scope: src/forex_bot/factory/validation_runner.py (small bridge hook: optional CPCV path on TrialReturnStore; default CSCV path unchanged)
tests/backtest/__init__.py (if present) — only if package marker missing
out_of_scope: src/forex_bot/srf/pbo.py (CSCV math stays as-is; CPCV math lives in cpcv.py; no duplicate CSCV code in the new module)
src/forex_bot/factory/pipeline_config.py (existing embargo_bars reused as-is; no new config fields)
All strategies, all templates, all live-trading code paths

edge_cases: T < N (insufficient bars to form N contiguous groups) → CPCVTooFewBars; CPCV runner returns phi=0
k > N or k <= 0 → CPCVConfig rejects at construction
label_horizon_bars=0, embargo_bars=0 → purge/embargo are no-ops (degenerate case; pass-through is correct)
Single strategy trial (N_trials=1) → CPCV requires N_trials >= 2; raise CPCVTooFewTrials (matches CSCV contract in compute_pbo)
All-zero matrix column (degenerate trial) → per-path Sharpe uses 1e-12 std floor (mirrors _sharpe_ratio in srf/pbo.py)
Matrix shorter than N*k minimum cell size → split degrades to floor(T/N) per group; documented
C(N, k) blows past MAX_CPCV_PATHS=65536 → cap by reducing k greedily until phi fits; log warning
Empty purged-train (every train obs got purged) → path returns is_sharpe=zeros and oos_sharpe=zeros; breach logic still defined (best-IS vs median-OOS)
test_min_idx = 0 (first group is test) → no train bars to the left; purge and embargo on the right side only

test_plan.name: test_cpcv_config_validates
test_plan.covers: CPCVConfig rejects k<=0, k>=N, label_horizon_bars<0, embargo_bars<0

test_plan.name: test_cpcv_paths_count_matches_combinatorics
test_plan.covers: phi = C(N,k) for N=6,k=3 (20), N=8,k=4 (70), N=7,k=3 (35); exact binomial identity

test_plan.name: test_cpcv_splits_are_contiguous_and_disjoint
test_plan.covers: Per-path test indices are a contiguous union of k group blocks; train = complement; train ∩ test = ∅; union = full range

test_plan.name: test_cpcv_purge_drops_label_overlap
test_plan.covers: Train obs whose label horizon (i, i+horizon) reaches into test_min are dropped from purged_train

test_plan.name: test_cpcv_embargo_drops_after_test_set
test_plan.covers: After purge, embargo_bars additional train obs adjacent to test edges are dropped

test_plan.name: test_cpcv_pbo_aggregates_path_breaches
test_plan.covers: compute_pbo_cpcv returns PBO in [0,1]; n_paths = phi; breaches = n_overfit paths; lower = better

test_plan.name: test_cpcv_dsr_in_path_distribution
test_plan.covers: compute_dsr_cpcv uses per-path OOS Sharpe distribution; effective_n_trials = phi

test_plan.name: test_cpcv_integrates_with_trial_return_store
test_plan.covers: TrialReturnStore.matrix() (the existing [T,N] CSCV source) feeds cpcv.run_cpcv without duplication

test_plan.name: test_cpcv_validates_input_matrix
test_plan.covers: Matrix [T,N] with N<2 or T<4 raises CPCVTooFewTrials / CPCVTooFewBars (mirrors srf/pbo contract)

test_plan.name: test_cpcv_phi_fits_max_paths
test_plan.covers: When C(N,k) > MAX_CPCV_PATHS, runner reduces k greedily and reports effective k

api_verification.verified_by: Read full file (707 lines); confirmed record/matrix/trial_count/reset/keys; matrix returns [T,N_trials] or None
Read full file (246 lines); confirmed CSCV math contract; CPCV mirrors it but uses contiguous splits + purge + embargo
Read pipeline_config.py:33-110; embargo_bars is wired per-TF (M5=288, M15=96, H1=24, H4=6, D1=1) — CPCV reuses these as the embargo_bars input
Confirmed Bar has .time/.close attributes; the matrix source is TrialReturnStore (returns matrix), not Bar objects directly

risk: Math correctness: purge + embargo must drop exactly the right indices or PBO silently shifts; mitigation: deterministic tiny tests on T=12, N=3 with explicit expected index sets before any statistical checks
Combinatorial blowup: C(N,k) for N=10,k=5 = 252 paths (fine); for N=20,k=10 = 184756 (over MAX_CPCV_PATHS); mitigation: greedy k reduction + warning + MAX_CPCV_PATHS cap matches CSCV pattern

Bridge stability: factory.ValidationRunner currently uses CSCV; switching default to CPCV would change PBO values mid-sprint; mitigation: CPCV is added as a parallel path (cpcv_run_cpcv) and the existing CSCV compute_pbo stays the default; no behavior change to existing verdicts

TrialReturnStore interface: matrix() truncates to min trial length so the [T,N] shape is rectangular; CPCV consumes this directly with no copy; verified against existing tests/factory/test_validation_runner.py

Worker-isolation on node: cpu_guard already caps at 1-2 CPUs; CPCV is combinatorial so wall time scales with phi*N_strategies; for N=8,k=4 (phi=70) and 17 strategies this is <1s on a single CPU; no risk
Embargo asymmetry: AFML defines embargo as post-test on the train side; CPCV applies it symmetrically (both sides of test set); documented in docstring to avoid future reader confusion
